title: MTR Loss Spike at Specific Hop
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mtr:trace loss_pct>5
stats max(loss_pct) as loss by hop_ip target_name
description: Identifies recurring packet loss at a specific MTR hop.
value: Surfacing mtr loss spike at specific hop helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant home network & connectivity export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It notices when mtr loss spike at specific hop matters for your routine.
